drivers.notes: Sheet power: RMS 2x 2500 W, Music 2x 5000 W (rms_w and peak_w are the two coils summed). Product page also says 20000 W peak at 50 Hz. Re given as '2x 1' ohm (per coil). Outer diameter 840 mm. DATA PROBLEM: Sd 402 cm2 as printed is not consistent with Vas 740 L, Mms 1234 g and Fs 25.17 Hz; those imply Sd about 4010 cm2 (calculated), so the printed Sd looks a factor of 10 low. Weight and total depth printed as '???' on the sheet. Sensitivity at 2.83 V/1 m.

drivers.notes: Sheet power: RMS 2x 2000 W, Musik 2x 2500 W (summed here). Product page adds 20000 W peak at 60 Hz. Re printed '2x 0.8' ohm (per coil), impedance 2x 1 ohm. Voice coil 76.2 mm. Calculated: Qes from Bl, Mms, Fs matches Re 0.4 ohm, i.e. the T/S look like coils in parallel (sheet does not say). Vas from Mms/Fs/Sd calculates to 24.96 L, matches. Box-recommendation figures in the PDF are laid out as a drawing; the vented volume 100 L and port diameter 9 cm are clear, the other numbers (20, 30, 55, 70) could not be assigned with certainty and are left out.

drivers.notes: Sheet power: RMS 2x 1100 W, Music 2x 1300 W (summed here). Re printed '2 x 1,9' ohm (per coil). Total installation depth 255 mm; 215 mm is 'Einbautiefe (e)'. Sheet says all box calculations include the woofer and an aeroport. Calculated: Qes from Bl/Mms/Fs implies Re about 4 ohm, i.e. T/S look like coils in series (sheet does not say).

drivers.notes: Sheet power: RMS 2x 1000 W, Music 2x 1200 W (summed here; exactly at the 2000 W threshold). Re printed '2 x 1,9' ohm (per coil). excluded_notes: X12 EVO BR-2 and X12 EVO BP-2 (2x 1500/1000 W, 2x 1 ohm) are loaded enclosures, not raw drivers; not recorded. All other Audio System subwoofer series (HX, Carbon, CO, M, Radion, SW, US, X-ion, Subframe) are below 2000 W RMS per https://www.audio-system.de/produkte/subwoofer/ series pages read 2026-11-21.
